cohort: The study included 14,497 maternal-neonatal pairs with liveborn infants born at >=24 weeks at four hospitals in one health system between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2020.
finding: While the maternal risk stratification score (EOCS) was associated with 5-minute Apgar <7, its predictive performance weakened with advancing gestational age and was not well-calibrated for term low-risk singletons, suggesting the association primarily reflects prematurity.
